facts.text: FTMO reserves the right to determine 'at our own discretion' whether trades fall within a Forbidden Trading Practice; acting reasonably, it may cancel trades and cancel all FTMO Accounts or rewards, without prior notice (endeavours to notify) and without compensation; may also impose temporary or permanent consistency measures.
